_source: Evil Mode rework (DOMINION) slice D1. Design: /mnt/project-files/plans/evil-mode-rework/ Part 1 sections 1-2, Part 6 sections 1-2, Part 7 section 1.1, Part 9 A1 and A15. Numbers are starting values; none are playtested.

types.bannedLine: Too proud to wear a uniform.

grunt.name: Rook
grunt.pitch: A Grunt is cheap and loyal and useless.
facts: A Lv 5 Pokémon of a Team Type

admin.pitch: An Admin is capable and expensive and might not stay.
facts: A Lv 7 Pokémon of a Team Type

opening: The warehouse smells like wet cardboard and Grimer. Rain comes through the roof in three places. Your one Grunt is trying to catch the drips in a Poké Ball, which doesn't work.
"Boss," he says. "Boss, I've been thinking about the plan."
adminOpening: The warehouse smells like wet cardboard and Grimer. Rain comes through the roof in three places. Your one Admin has found the only dry crate and is sitting on it.
"This is it?" they say. "You told me there was a building."
"...You told me there was a roof."

orders.label: Scout the block
orders.report: You walk the block twice. The mart's back door sticks, and nobody watches the alley after dark.

orders.label: Find a recruit
orders.report: A dockhand at the noodle stand says he knows a man who knows a man. You leave him your name. That's a contact.

orders.label: Secure the warehouse
orders.report: A chain, a padlock and a crate against the door. It won't stop anyone, but you'll hear them.

grunt: We're short-staffed... You got any ideas?
I put a bucket under the big drip. Progress!
Boss, is the plan still the plan?
Night shift? I'll stand by the door. Very scary.
admin: I've seen better hideouts in a Magikarp.
Give me a real job and I'll do it.
Pay day is Sunday. I'll remind you.
The roof is not a metaphor. It's leaking.

report.rest: You slept. Your Pokémon are rested. Well rested: +1 action today.
report.tired: You didn't rest. {n} nights in a row now.
report.exhausted: Exhausted: one action fewer until you rest.
report.cool: The street forgets a little. Heat {heat}%.
report.broke: Not enough to pay everyone. {name} went unpaid.

lockedTab: Opens in a later part of the Dominion build.
